links.evidence: One of our customers, Han's Laser, headquartered in China, accounted for 12%, 13% and 9% of our net sales in 2018, 2017 and 2016, respectively.
On July 5, 2018, we and Embraer S.A. (Embraer) announced the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding to establish a strategic partnership between the two companies.
The primary competitor for our McAfee family of security products and services is Symantec Corporation.
We also have an agreement with JVC America Inc. under which JVC provides secondary outsourced manufacturing volume for these launches and for day-to-day replenishment.
Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. accounted for approximately 12% , 7% and 4% of our total revenue in fiscal years 2016 , 2015 and 2014 , respectively.
Sales through our largest distributor, Tech Data Corporation and its affiliates, accounted for 23% , 17% and 16% of our net revenue for fiscal years 2013 , 2012 and 2011 , respectively.
